THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE M G UMA  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE M G UMA) Petitioner Nos.2 to 8 being accused Nos.2 to 8 in Crime No.118/2024 of Manvi Police Station, now pending in C.C.No.1022/2024 on the file of the learned Civil Judge and JMFC, Manvi registered for the offences punishable under Sections 143, 147, 498A,
420, 307, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 149 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 [for short, 'the IPC']
and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 [for short, 'the D.P. Act'] are seeking to quash the criminal proceedings initiated against them on the basis of the first information lodged by respondent No.2.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:5189 HC-KAR 2.

Heard Sri Basavaraj R. Math, learned counsel for the petitioner and Smt. Arati Patil, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1 - State, Sri B.K. Patil, learned counsel for respondent No.2.
Perused the materials on record.

3. In view of the rival contentions urged by the learned counsel for both the parties, the point that would arise for my consideration is:
Whether the criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners is liable to be quashed invoking inherent power under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023?

My answer to the above point is in the 'Affirmative' for the following:
REASONS 4. Respondent No.2 filed the first information against accused Nos.1 to 8 alleging commission of the offence as stated above.
Initially the first information was filed with Sindhanoor Town police Station on 26.04.2024 NC: 2025:KHC-K:5189 HC-KAR which was registered in Crime No.59/2024.

sentences.text:
the same was transferred to Manvi Police Station and re-numbered as Crime No.118/2024.
5.
It is the contention of respondent No.2 that she is a divorcee, having a son aged 11 years.
She came in contact with accused No.1 in a matrimonial site and they married on 10.01.2021.
After marriage, accused No.1, respondent No.2 and her son started residing together.
It is alleged that on 14.02.2021 at about 9.00 a.m. accused Nos.2 to 8 came and abused respondent No.2 in filthy language, assaulted her and criminally intimidated to take away her life.
It is also alleged that accused No.1 started ill-treating her demanding dowry.
He treated her with cruelty both mentally and physically.
On 28.07.2023 at 11.00 p.m. accused No.1 tried to strangulate her neck, insisted her to leave his house.

She also stated that accused No.1 made false representation that he is an unmarried man and managed to marry her and NC: 2025:KHC-K:5189 HC-KAR subsequently treated her with cruelty, tried to cause her death and criminally intimidated her by demanding dowry.
6. On going through the first information and the final report filed by the Investigating Officer, it is clear that the grievance of respondent No.2 is mainly against accused No.1 who is her husband.
Petitioner Nos.2 to 8 being accused Nos.2 to 8 are all his family members.
Only allegation against them is that on 14.02.2021 they have abused and assaulted her.
The first information came to be filed belatedly on 26.04.2024 i.e., after lapse of more than 3 years.
No medical records are produced to show that on the said date respondent No.2 had sustained any injuries.
Except bald and general allegations made against accused Nos.2 to 8, there is absolutely no material to accept the same.
Under such circumstances, I am of the opinion that petitioner Nos.2 to 8 being the family members of accused No.1 were implicated only to pressurize him for terms.
Therefore, continuation of criminal proceedings against them is in abuse of process of NC: 2025:KHC-K:5189 HC-KAR law.
Accordingly, it is to be quashed.

Hence, I answer the above point in the 'affirmative' and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER (i) The Criminal Petition is allowed.
(ii) Criminal proceedings initiated against petitioner Nos.2 to 8 (accused Nos.2 to 8)
in Crime No.118/2024 of Manvi Police Station, pending in C.C.No.1022/2024, on the file of learned Civil Judge and JMFC, Manvi for the offences punishable under Sections 143, 147, 498A, 420, 307, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 149 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 is hereby quashed.

Sd/-
(M G UMA) JUDGE SWK CT:PK Gururaj vs The State Of Karnataka on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163620584/
